items.title: KKR (KKR) Moves Ahead With STT GDC India Stake Sale
items.summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR), Singtel and Tata Group are proceeding with a planned multi billion dollar sale of their stakes in STT GDC India to rebalance capital. The shareholders aim to benefit from strong demand for data center capacity as they explore options for the STT GDC India stake sale.
